scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy -c ../../wrangler.submit.jsonc && wrangler d1 execute DB -c ../../wrangler.submit.jsonc --remote --command "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS submissions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT, contact TEXT, title TEXT, tags TEXT DEFAULT '[]', description TEXT DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, r2_prefix TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, approved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, published_commit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');"
